shared.emailHelp: Sirf tab jab aap jawab chahte hain. Hum ise aur kisi cheez ke liye istemaal nahi karenge.
shared.honeypotLabel: Is field ko khaali chhod dein
shared.notFoundPrompt: Yahaan kuch hone ki ummeed thi? <link>Humein bataiye</link> taaki hum link theek kar sakein.
shared.switchHeading: Sahi jagah nahi? Iske bajaye inmein se koi ek try karein.

deviceConsent.label: Team ko is par gaur karne mein madad ke liye meri device ki jaankari shaamil karein
deviceConsent.items: Aap jis page par hain, aapka browser aur device type, aapki bhasha, screen size aur time zone. Kabhi bhi aapka IP address, aapka naam, ya aapka location nahi.
deviceConsent.note: Aap yeh form iske bina bhi bhej sakte hain.

supportSignpost.heading: Support dhoondh rahe hain?
supportSignpost.body: Yeh form us team tak pahunchta hai jo Bloom banaati hai — hamari support team tak nahi, aur ise har waqt monitor nahi kiya jaata. Agar aap apni healing ya jo kuch aap guzar rahe hain uske baare mein kisi se baat karna chahte hain, toh hum aapke liye yahaan hain.

success.title: Message bhej diya gaya
success.body: Humein batane ke liye samay nikaalne ka shukriya. Yahaan jo kuch bhi aata hai, hum sab padhte hain.
success.bodyWithEmail: Humein batane ke liye shukriya. Agar hamare koi sawaal honge, toh hum aapko {email} par email karenge.
success.bugBody: Report karne ke liye shukriya. Aise details Bloom ko sabke liye zyada reliable banane mein hamari madad karte hain.

errors.messageRequired: Bhejne se pehle kuch shabd likhiye.
errors.feedbackEmpty: Upar se koi option chuniye, ya ek comment jodiye taaki hum samajh sakein aap kya kehna chahte hain.
errors.emailInvalid: Yeh email address sahi nahi lag raha.
errors.submitFailed: Hum abhi aapka message nahi bhej paaye. Kripya thodi der mein dobara koshish karein, ya <link>team ko seedhe email karein</link>.

bug.title: Bug report karein
bug.intro: Kuch theek se kaam nahi kar raha? Humein bataiye aapne kya dekha aur hum ise dekhenge.
bug.messagePlaceholder: jaise, maine ek session video par play tap kiya aur screen safed ho gayi
bug.expectedLabel: Aapko kya hone ki ummeed thi?
bug.stepsLabel: Yeh hone se theek pehle aap kya kar rahe the?
bug.stepsPlaceholder:
1. Library kholi
2. 'Courses' se filter kiya
3. Pehle card par tap kiya
bug.blockingLabel: Kya aap phir bhi Bloom istemaal kar sakte hain?

feedback.title: Apna feedback share karein
feedback.intro: Hum Bloom ko hamesha behtar bana rahe hain. Bataiye yeh aapke liye kaisa kaam kar raha hai — har baat maayne rakhti hai.
feedback.tagsLabel: Kya khaas laga? Jo bhi sahi lage chuniye.
feedback.brokeNudge: Agar kuch kharaab hai, toh ek <link>bug report</link> humein ise tezi se theek karne mein madad karti hai.
feedback.commentPlaceholder: Kya achha chal raha hai, kya pareshaan karta hai, aap kya dekhna chahenge…

contact.title: Bloom team se sampark karein
contact.intro: Koi sawaal hai, ya Bloom ya apne account ke baare mein kuch kehna hai? Yahaan bhejiye.

reasons.question: Ek aam sawaal
reasons.account_login: Mera account ya sign in karna

contact.messagePlaceholder: Bataiye aap kya poochhna ya share karna chahenge
